* Innovation and Thought Leadership: Stay updated with the latest technology advancements and drive innovation within the firm and for clients, defining best practices.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically requires 15+ years of relevant industry experience in AI, data analytics, software development, or consulting, with a significant portion in a leadership or management role.
* Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

**Technical Proficiency:**

* Hands on knowledge with all Big data and cloud data engineering stack
* Strong technical and hands on experience in building analytics applications
* Should have deep knowledge of complex solution architecting; have worked on various technologies, application space, data security and governance

**Soft Skills:**
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical details into clear business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

description:
**Project Role :**
Technology Support Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. **Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education

CL-10
  
  
Role: Azure Kubernetes Specialist
  
  
Total experience: 6+ years of progressive experience in IT
  
  
Relevant experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in managing Azure Kubernetes Platform.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly proficient Azure Cloud Container & Platform Engineer (5–8 years of experience) to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for architecting, deploying, and maintaining secure, scalable, and production-grade containerized platforms on Azure. You will focus on the end-to-end lifecycle of containerized workloads, spanning from development to deployment across Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, and Azure App Service (Container Runtime), all underpinned by robust Azure DevOps CI/CD strategies.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Automation: Design, build, and maintain Azure Kubernetes, Container, Container Instances, Azure Web App Container Runtime using Bicep, ARM, Terraforom Automate the provisioning of key components including Key Vault (secrets/certificates), User Assigned Managed Identities (UAMI), Storage Accounts, and comprehensive monitoring workspaces.
  
  
Kubernetes Resource Management (AKS): Architect, deploy, and manage Kubernetes resources following GitOps best practices. This includes managing Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, and implementing Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA) and Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB) to ensure workload reliability.
  
  
Container Runtime & App Service Management: Configure and optimize the execution environment for containerized web applications within Azure App Service and Azure Container Apps, ensuring seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Image Management & Registry (ACR): Oversee Azure Container Registry (ACR) lifecycles, including geo-replication, image lifecycle policies, and secure image scanning.
  
  
Networking & Traffic Management: Deploy and manage Ingress controllers (NGINX), configure private endpoints, and implement robust traffic routing and load balancing strategies for both AKS and App Service containers.
  
  
Security, Governance & Compliance: Enforce enterprise security standards using Azure RBAC, Workload Identities, and network segmentation (NSGs/Firewalls). Manage secret rotation via Key Vault + CSI driver integration.
  
  
Observability: Configure full-stack monitoring using Azure Monitor for Containers, Application Insights, and Prometheus/Grafana to build real-time dashboards for infrastructure and application health.
  
  
AKS Upgrades: Handling AKS Cluster and Node upgrades seamlessly without impact to business operations.
  
  
Platform Operations: Support containerized application lifecycles using Kubernetes architect and manage robust CI/CD pipelines and drive proactive monitoring and rapid troubleshooting of cluster-wide issues.
  
  
Security & Regulatory Compliance: Enforce enterprise-grade security via RBAC, complex network policies, and encryption ensure strict adherence to industry-specific compliance frameworks such as RBI and PCI DSS.
  
  
Strategic Leadership: Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Azure Kubernetes, Container mentoring engineering teams and championing the adoption of GitOps practices.
  
  
**Requirements & Qualifications**
Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure, with deep expertise in Azure Kubernetes and container orchestration.
  
  
Technical Expertise:
  
  

* Containers: Expert knowledge of Docker, image optimization, and container runtime environments (AKS, Azure Container Apps, App Service).
* Orchestration: Deep understanding of Kubernetes resources, Helm, and GitOps workflows.
* IaC: Advanced proficiency in Bicep, ARM template, Terraform
* Cloud Foundation: Strong knowledge of Azure Networking (VNets/NSGs), Storage, and Identity (UAMI/Workload Identity).
* DevOps: Proven experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, service connections, and artifact repositories.

Certification Required:
  
  

* Cloud: Microsoft Certified: AZ-305, AZ-400
* Platform: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).

Professional Attributes: Excellent troubleshooting skills across Linux, Kubernetes, and Azure strong commitment to standardization, security-first design, and audit compliance.
  
  
Professional Experience/Attribute
  
  
Strong familiarity with Azure cloud services with deep and comprehensive knowledge of DNS, Networking.
  
  
Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex data.
  
  
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working with cross-functional teams.
  
  
Adept at defining and tracking KPIs for performance improvement.
  
  
Prior experience in monitoring and analyzing cloud cost trends.
  
  
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  
  
Ability to create and maintain documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Highly self-motivated individuals with the ability to identify areas of focus and tackle new challenges.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to deliver clear and measurable results, aligned with planned goals.
  
  
Strong analytical skills for extracting insights and actionable items from available data.
  
  
Adaptability to work in a dynamic international environment.
  
  
Exceptional teamwork and communication skills.
  
  
Promotes open sharing of views and encourages collaboration.
  
  
Strong oral, written, and presentation abilities in English.
  
  
Commitment to standardization and simplification in all work aspects.

title: Salesforce Technical Manager - Core Data
description:
**Description**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team.
  
  
In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a Data Architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s platform and core data fundamentals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a data/technical architect) on billable projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants/Architects

+ Define and govern the overall data architecture strategy across Salesforce orgs, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with enterprise data standards
+ Own end-to-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation
+ Advise clients on Salesforce object model best practices — standard vs. custom objects, relationships (lookup, master-detail, polymorphic), and schema design
+ Lead decisions on data access patterns, sharing model, OWD, role hierarchy, and field-level security as they relate to data architecture
+ Establish data governance frameworks, data ownership models, and data stewardship practices
+ Design solutions across multi-org, multi-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Industries Cloud and Experience Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality customer solutions.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Data360 and Agentblazer Legend
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Sharing and Visibility (Good to have)
* Platform Security (Good to have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security (Good to have)
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, App Builder, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.

title: Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno-Functional)
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno\-Functional)
   

  

**Location:** 
 India(Remote)
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 8\+ Years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Salesforce CPQ Business Systems Analyst (Techno\-Functional) to lead solution design and delivery for complex Quote\-to\-Cash (QTC) transformation initiatives. In this role, you will bridge business strategy and hands\-on technical architecture—translating SaaS subscription models, multi\-product bundles, and data workflows into scalable Salesforce CPQ configurations and integration specifications. Candidates must have personally configured Salesforce CPQ and must have practical, hands\-on experience building AI agents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Quote\-to\-Cash Solution Design: Map and optimize the end\-to\-end sales journey, covering account creation/validation, opportunity management, quote generation, contract finalization, and order confirmation.
* Salesforce CPQ Architecture and Configuration: Design and maintain complex bundle structures (components vs. accessories), subscription/term\-based pricing models, renewal logic, and Quote Line Editor product/validation rules.
* Account Onboarding, MDM \& Routing: Design account creation and approval workflows. Configure territory and user routing based on geography, revenue, and employee headcount.
* Integration \& Data Architecture: Partner with engineering teams to define integration specs between Salesforce CPQ, Master Data Management (Informatica MDM), middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi), and downstream invoicing engines. Define the Salesforce and Informatica MDM integration for account validation, enrichment, and deduplication. This includes resolving conflicts between third\-party data (ZoomInfo, D\&B, SEC) and existing MDM records.
* Data \& Technical Validation: Write SOQL queries to analyze data models, troubleshoot configuration edge cases, and validate data migrations/enrichment pipelines.
* AI \& Emerging Tech: Assist in evaluating and setting up native AI capabilities (e.g., Salesforce Agentforce, sub\-agents) to automate internal workflows and user journeys.
* Agile Story Authoring: Write detailed user stories, process flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria while partnering with offshore development teams to drive sprint execution.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in the Salesforce ecosystem, with at least 4\+ years dedicated to Salesforce CPQ (SteelBrick) implementation and business analysis.
* CPQ Expertise: Hands\-on mastery of Salesforce CPQ configurations—including complex product rules, pricing waterfalls, price rules, and subscription management.
* Integration Knowledge: Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, and tools such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica MDM.
* Technical Acumen: Ability to write SOQL queries, read APEX data structures, and understand complex object relationships within Salesforce.
* Process Mastery: Deep functional understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash, SaaS billing models, and contract lifecycle workflows.
* Emerging AI: Exposure to or strong foundational knowledge of Salesforce Agentforce and AI agent configurations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, or subscription\-first technology companies.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




  





**EternUp is building the digital twin for human life — an AI operating system that connects your time, work, relationships, health, knowledge and finances into one continuously evolving model of you. Powered by Continuo, our personal context layer, EternUp understands not just what you ask for, but what's happening and what should happen next — then acts on it through Aeon, an AI chief of staff that coordinates specialized agents across your calendar, tasks, health, and logistics. We're the human side of a two\-sided platform: the same digital\-twin technology powers Twinamics for businesses. This is a new category, not a calendar app or a wellness tracker — and we're building the infrastructure for it from the ground up.** 




  





**Role Description** 




**As a Founding Engineer at EternUp, you'll design, build, and scale the core systems behind our digital twin: the context layer that ingests and models a person's life, the agent runtime that lets Aeon act safely on their behalf, and the day\-design and task systems users touch every day. You'll work across a modern stack (Next.js/React, Postgres, agentic AI orchestration) and collaborate directly with the founders to turn product and architectural decisions into shipped, tested code. Day to day, this means high\-quality backend and full\-stack work, sound engineering judgment on what an autonomous agent should and shouldn't be allowed to do, and end\-to\-end ownership of features from spec to production. This is a full\-time hybrid role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with a mix of on\-site collaboration and flexible work\-from\-home days.** 




  





**Qualifications** 



* Full\-stack engineering: strong TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js on the frontend, Node/Postgres on the backend — able to build and ship a feature end\-to\-end alone
* GUI/frontend craft: can build clean, responsive interfaces from scratch and implement a design system precisely (spacing, typography, states) — not just plug in a component library
* Agentic systems, built not bolted on: has built agent loops, tool\-calling, or orchestration logic from open\-source frameworks or from scratch (LangGraph, CrewAI, custom loops) — not just prompting a hosted API and calling it done
* Actuator/automation layer: experience building systems that take real\-world actions on a user's behalf — action registries, permission gating, execution logs — using self\-hosted or open\-source tooling (e.g., browser automation via Playwright/CDP, not a paid automation SaaS)
* Open\-source\-first instinct: default to self\-hosting and open\-source stacks (Postgres, open LLMs where viable, open queues/workers, open auth) over proprietary APIs and managed SaaS wherever it's practical
* CI/CD and infra: can set up and maintain build/test/deploy pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), containerization (Docker), and basic cloud infra without hand\-holding
* Systems/backend depth: comfortable with databases, auth, queues, and API design — not just frontend\-adjacent scripting
* Startup ownership: writes production\-quality code fast, debugs down to root cause, and takes a feature from idea to deployed without needing a spec for every detail

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
* **Role:**



 Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Gemini Enterprise, Agentic AI, and Multi\-Agent Systems
 



 Responsibilities
 


* Design, develop, and deploy production\-grade Multi\-Agent Systems (MAS) and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise
* Identify need for Pro Code Vs No Code design based on customer’s problem statement and data sources
* Design Deployand custom agents using the Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine and integrate with Gemini Enterprise
* Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem (Docs, Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Meet) and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery.
* Architect scalable short\-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long\-term memory architectures across multi\-agent interactions.
* Implement end\-to\-end authentication and authorization perimeters for agents, Google Cloud services, and 3rd\-party SaaS integrations (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID / M365, Salesforce, Atlassian) using IAM, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, and service identities.
* Enforce fine\-grained Access Control Lists (ACLs), user/group permission inheritance, and data governance policies to ensure agents strictly adhere to enterprise access boundaries.
* Utilize developer tooling including Agent CLI and Antigravity for local rapid prototyping, testing, emulation, distributed tracing, and root cause analysis (RCA).
* Architect Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows, ensuring seamless Interrupt and Resume patterns between autonomous agents and human experts for critical decision points.
* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to manage versioned agent deployments, automated testing, and continuous regression evaluations.
* Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain\-of\-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan\-and\-Solve, and Self\-Reflection to enhance agent reliability.
* Establish quantitative evaluation frameworks to measure agent trajectories, tool invocation precision/recall, and reasoning faithfulness.
* Collaborate directly with client engineering and architecture teams to deploy, validate, and operationalize enterprise agentic AI solutions in client environments.



 Must\-Have Skills
 


* Core Engineering \& Frameworks: Strong proficiency in Python with production\-level software engineering practices, along with deep, hands\-on experience building multi\-agent systems using Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) or comparable agentic frameworks.
* Gemini \& Workspace Ecosystem: Solid hands\-on experience deploying and customizing Gemini Enterprise, NotebookLM, and integrating with the broader Google Workspace Ecosystem (APIs, Add\-ons, Drive/Docs connectors).
* Memory \& State Architecture: Demonstrated expertise in managing agent session state, short\-term context caching, and durable long\-term memory backends (vector databases, relational/NoSQL session stores).
* Third Party Tools: Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third\-party platforms (e.g., iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity, DocuSign, MS Office Suite, Sharepoint, JIRA) with Gemini Enterprise.
* Auth \& Security: Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (IAM, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, Service Accounts, Workload Identity Federation) across Google Cloud and 3rd\-party SaaS platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, Atlassian).
* ACLs \& Permissions: Deep working knowledge of enterprise Access Control Lists (ACLs), identity federation, permission trimming, and role\-based access control (RBAC) across heterogeneous data sources.
* Developer Tooling: Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing.
* CI/CD \& DevOps: Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions) for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation.
* Evaluation \& Debugging: Practical knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing root cause analysis (RCA) on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions.
* Client Collaboration: Strong technical communication, consulting acumen, and client\-facing collaboration skills within an Agile environment.

title: Large Language Model Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Large Language Model Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Google Cloud Data Services
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Snowflake Data Warehouse, Microsoft Azure Data Services
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third\-party AI services to deliver production\-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.
   

  

 Formulate real\-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions
   

  

 Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps \& MLOps
   

  

 Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements \- including edge device and HPC
   

  

 Engage in research and development of new AI and high\-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites
   

  

 Work with large\-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high\-quality input for training and production
   

  

 Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools
   

  

 Justify the value of model approaches in business problems
   

  

 Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end\-to\-end project goals and integrate into production
   

  

 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
   

  

 Minimum of 5 years of experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.
   

  

 Minimum of 5 years of experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming
   

  

 Minimum of 3 years of experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high\-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks
   

  

 Minimum of 2 years of experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and python\-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..
   

  

 Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.
   

  

 Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C\+\+, Java, R, SQL
   

  

 Strong written \& verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
   

  

 Strong client\-facing skillsets in a consulting environment
   

  

 Strong cross\-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client\-side teams
   

  

 Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation
   

  

 MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)
   

  

 As a Large Language Model Architect, a typical day involves designing and structuring advanced language models capable of understanding and generating human\-like text. This role requires envisioning the architecture of neural networks that are trained on extensive datasets, ensuring the models can effectively process natural language. The workday includes analyzing model performance, refining parameters, and collaborating with various teams to integrate these models into broader applications. Continuous innovation and problem\-solving are key aspects, as the architect shapes the future capabilities of language\-based artificial intelligence systems.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of scalable language model architectures to meet project goals.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to foster professional growth.
* Coordinate cross\-functional efforts to align model development with organizational objectives.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Google Cloud Data Services.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Snowflake Data Warehouse, Microsoft Azure Data Services.
* Strong expertise in designing and optimizing neural network architectures for natural language processing.
* Experience with large\-scale data processing and management in cloud environments.
* Ability to analyze and improve model training processes using extensive unlabeled datasets.
* Familiarity with integrating language models into production systems and ensuring their scalability and reliability.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Google Cloud Data Services.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support SAS Viya 4 environments in enterprise production settings.
* Perform platform configuration, upgrades, patching, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance.
* Manage SAS Viya services, compute environments, CAS, SAS Studio, users, groups, roles, and authorization controls.
* Troubleshoot application, compute, storage, and performance issues within SAS Viya.
* Support and manage SAS Viya deployments on Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.
* Investigate and resolve issues related to pods, deployments, services, persistent volumes, storage, nodes, resource limits, and application logs.
* Configure and troubleshoot integrations between SAS Viya and AWS services including EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, and VPC components.
* Manage IAM roles, policies, service accounts, permissions, and cross\-account accessrequirements.
* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Terraform\-based infrastructure as code for cloud resources and platform deployments.
* Create and manage Terraform modules, variables, plans, state files, and deployment workflows.
* Configure and support enterprise authentication and SSO integrations using Okta, SAML, LDAP/Active Directory, OAuth/OIDC, or similar technologies.
* Troubleshoot authentication, MFA, authorization, SSO, and role\-mapping issues.
* Support platform security requirements including certificates, TLS/SSL, networking, and connectivity.
* Perform performance tuning, capacity planning, and optimization across CPU, memory, storage, and I/O layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Terraform, Python, Shell, and SAS scripting.
* Support migration activities from SAS 9\.4/Grid to SAS Viya 4\.
* Collaborate with AWS, Security, IAM, Network, Database, and Application teams to ensure seamless platform operations.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
 Candidates must demonstrate strong technical depth across SAS Viya administration, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
   

  

* 6\+ years of experience in SAS Administration.
* Hands\-on experience administering SAS Viya 4 environments.
* Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, S3, Lambda and VPC.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes concepts including Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVC/PV, Storage Classes, and resource management.
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon EKS.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Experience with enterprise authentication technologies such as Okta, SAML, OAuth, SSO, MFA, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of LDAP/Active Directory and role\-based access control.
* Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience with SAS Viya monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Python and Shell scripting for automation.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
 The ideal candidate will bring a combination of strong technical capability, operational discipline, and collaboration skills to support a modern enterprise analytics platform.
   

  

* Experience with SAS 9\.4 Grid/SAS Viya 4 administration.
* SAS Viya or AWS certification.
* Exposure to Helm, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, or CI/CD tools and practices.
* Experience with AWS Glue, Redshift, Snowflake, or other cloud data platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments and cloud migration projects.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams in infrastructure, security, and application domains.
* Proactive approach to automation, optimization, and operational improvement.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 6\-10 Years of Total experience, 3\-4 years of SAS Viya Administration, and 2\-3 years of AWS experience, having hood hands\-on and knowledge in Terraform/DevOps/Jenkins.

Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk\-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk\-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit \& Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
   

  

**Role Summary/ Purpose**
 The
 **eGRC Solution Architect** 
 is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk \& Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
 **automate, standardize, and integrate** 
 governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end\-to\-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end\-to\-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology\-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5\+ years of hands\-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5\+ years designing and delivering end\-to\-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target\-state architecture, standards, and non\-functional requirements.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade\-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience


**Work Timings:** 
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
 We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)
